title: Investigation of the structural, optical and electrical properties of ZnAl2O4
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23129-23135
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01381C, Paper

Amira Bougoffa, Ala Eddin Mabrouki, Adel Benali, Essebti Dhahri, Abderrazek Oueslati, B. F. O. Costa
A pure normal spinel structured ZnAl2O4 nanopowder, synthesized using an auto-combustion route, exhibits multicolor emission at room temperature and semiconductor behavior following the Jonscher law at higher frequencies.
